subtitle: One query, every difference from this chapter

code:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name + ' ' + c.last_name AS full_name,
    o.order_id, o.order_total,
    CASE WHEN o.order_total > 500 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Standard' END AS order_size,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_total DESC) AS rn
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT TOP 100 customer_id, full_name, order_id, order_total, order_size
FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY order_total DESC;
caption: TOP, string plus, CASE, and a CTE wrapping ROW_NUMBER — four things this chapter covered.

code:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name,
  o.order_id, o.order_total,
  IFF(o.order_total > 500, 'Large', 'Standard') AS order_size,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_total DESC) AS rn
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
QUALIFY rn <= 3
ORDER BY o.order_total DESC
LIMIT 100;
caption: No CTE needed — QUALIFY filters the window function directly.
